summary: Requested a repeat of the fixed heartbeat jitter experiment (f13b5528eeb44ca99621e36f1c0f1ff0-experiment) rather than a new one. That account's weakest number is the no-delay arm, where three runs of 200 attempts produced 0, 0 and 2 inversions, so its non-zero rate rests on two events, while the jittered arm produced 90, 97 and 105 and is comparatively well pinned. Re-running the same saved harness and inputs adds a fourth independent pair of arms at identical attempt counts and cluster shape, with no change to the code under test or to the measurement. Staying near zero in the no-delay arm and inside the ninety-to-one-hundred-and-five band in the jittered arm would leave the current reading intact; several no-delay inversions, or a jittered arm far outside that band, would change how the rate is stated in the counterevidence. The submission is a repeat request with rationale only and validates against submission.schema.json.
